items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: "He was down there with Art Tatum and this guy..." and "Or Tatum, and all that fun."

ctx.x: We were talking. We were talking. We were talking. We were talking. We were talking before about Guy Kelly and South Stand being with the Bulls. Oh yeah. Guy Kelly. Yeah. That's the story about it. What happened? Yeah.

Well, he was playing with the Bulls out there. And around one o'clock just before they closed up time, Guy Kelly, they played fireworks, you know, it's an introduction, something like that. You understand? That's why Guy come on like that. And what I mean, we was, Kuyper had shot a number at him, stomping at the Savoy, you know? And Guy come back with that. And right after that night he went to Chicago with, started playing Three Deucers down in State Street. He was down there with Art Tatum and this guy, da you…
